central_claim: Task adaptation strongly improves prediction, but closed-loop benefit is conditional on predictor-risk-interaction coupling under the shared supervisor.

hypotheses.claim: At rollout-macro aggregation, B1 reduces frozen-test NLL relative to B0 by 0.314 nats/step; the small response-active subset remains a separate diagnostic.
The two matched-head comparisons point in different directions; tested Transformers do not show a consistent advantage over MLP adapters.
B1 prediction gains jointly improve completion and separation in only 2/8 corrected closed-loop cells.
Adaptive risk dominates fixed risk in only 3/12 corrected comparisons.
